subject: Mobile Development
title: Android's China Problem
description: A quick win: understand Android's China Problem.

hook.text: China is the world's largest smartphone market, but Google Play is banned there.

buildup.text: Chinese manufacturers like Huawei, Xiaomi, and Oppo run Android without Google services.

discovery.text: Each brand runs its own app store. Developers must publish to dozens of Chinese stores.

twist.text: Huawei built its own OS, HarmonyOS, after US sanctions blocked its access to Google.

climax.text: Android dominates in China, but Google gets almost no revenue from the world's biggest market.

punchline.text: Android won China; Google lost it.

quiz.question: Why doesn't Google Play work in China?
options: It's banned by the Chinese government
Google chose not to launch there
